raw_feedback_text:
- There was no aim of strain optimization. The Base Structure had a higher depth compared to the Valve. The EDIKB shows evidence that increasing vertical offset increases strain.
- Base Structure is longer than required. Correlation between strain results and EA-BS length was not done.
- Basis of selecting P-S supports was not given. Is there evidence that the region between P-S supports experiences a bending moment below 90 percent of the pipeline, including the stiff object in that space?
- It was not asked whether a Top Frame is required to protect the Valve.
- Basis of the spacing between connectors was not provided.

structured_feedback.pmap_issue: Compound valve and EA-SB design feedback.
